# `mise tool-stubs sync`

- **Usage:** `mise tool-stubs sync [--into <DIR>] [-f --force] <MANIFEST>`
- **Effect:** modifies state
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/tool_stubs.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/tool_stubs.rs)

Create or update the executable stubs declared by a manifest

## Arguments
- **`<MANIFEST>`** — Path to the tool-stub bundle manifest

## Flags
- **`--into <DIR>`** — Directory in which to write commands [default: ~/.local/bin]
- **`-f --force`** — Replace modified or conflicting command files
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
